scope: Paired development diagnostic; not scratch convergence or formal acceptance.

intervention: Only simulation.procedural.start_sampling changes from distance_curriculum to existing stratified sampler.
hypothesis: Training reset coverage limited to20/50/80m contributes to loss on approximately96m starts. Existing stratified resets include nominal-like long starts, broad starts and near-goal starts on independently generated training geometry.
evidence: Previously completed initial-state-audit.json and depth-h512-lambda1-minibatches4/outcomes.json. Within-training regression also exists; coverage is not asserted as the sole cause.
held_fixed: Same complete actor/critic/optimizer/RNG/environment/memory state; h512 lambda1 minibatches4 epochs4 gamma1 learning rates reward scoped deterministic update and evaluation cases.
source_reuse: Reuse completed source hash and fixed48 initial replay. Recheck rollout likelihood/recurrent correctness once because reset sampling changes.
runtime_measurement: Log current active worlds' start-distance range and count over90m each update. These are in-flight world coverage, not reset-frequency estimates.
decision: Promotion requires at least17/21 original successes retained at actual final312. Compare every check with completed control; record new/lost successes and termination causes. Failure rejects coverage change as sufficient within this budget.
limitations: No evaluation trajectories used in training. Source in-flight episodes stay unchanged until reset. A successful diagnostic still requires independent scratch seeds and long PPO stability validation.
